run_detail.final_report_title: 研究报告：比较 Terraform 与 Pulumi 的状态存储、加锁和并发修改控制方式，引用官方文档。
run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# Terraform 与 Pulumi 的状态存储、加锁与并发修改控制比较 本次核验的官方资料显示，Terraform 默认由 local 后端把状态存到本地磁盘的 JSON 文件，也可通过 backend 块或 HCP Terraform 将状态存放在远端；是否加锁取决于后端，支持锁定后端的场景下，Terraform 会对所有可能写状态的操作自动加锁，若加锁失败则不会继续。Pulumi 的 filesystem 与云存储后端既可在本地也可在云对象存储中保存状态，DIY 后端默认启用基于文件的锁定，状态存储在 locks/ 目录下保存锁文件。 ## 直接回答 在状态存储方面，Terraform 的 local 后端（默认后端）把状态保存为本地磁盘上的 JSON 文件，同时也可以通过集成 HCP Terraform 或定义 backend 块把状态存放到远端对象；使用非本地后端时，除写入后端失败这类不可恢复错误外，Terraform 不会在磁盘上持久化状态。Pulumi 的 filesystem 与云存储后端则允许把状态保存在本机或云对象存储中，DIY 后端通过 pulumi login 指定 s3://、azblob://、gs:// 或 file:// 等存储端点。 [evidence:3cac2f01297008a6d06016ce03c206f42bcaaacebc744ff7] [evidence:172dab1d1f228815dbdf2cf3bb9d8dd87389a254fcdacc1c] [evidence:de481c62892df18caa82088dd8abb1d70ad2ee635b993f27] [evidence:a0bcaf760ba2d59474791145fb84353af7a844e278cfd81b] [evidence:0708d32226e790e7d12cb000657b164fa4a5c42c820f7bbe] [evidence:e06e10be6c5aa9ee407e4db9d2a1480a97c82b71c2b0320b] [evidence:fa00e7e064fa9c97b6727cdee1c9d2da2ebc1d2fb6dadca4] 在加锁与并发修改控制方面，Terraform 把状态锁定的支持交给后端：后端在可能时负责支持状态锁定，并非所有后端都支持锁定，具体需查看各后端文档。对于支持锁定的后端，Terraform 会在所有可能写状态的操作上自动加锁，以防止他人获取锁并损坏状态；这一过程不显示提示信息，而一旦状态锁定失败，Terraform 不会继续执行。解锁时 force-unlock 命令要求提供唯一的锁 ID，该 ID 在解锁失败时由 Terraform 输出，充当 nonce 以确保锁与解锁指向正确的锁。Pulumi 方面，DIY 后端内置状态锁定和变更历史跟踪，对所有 DIY 后端默认启用基本的基于文件的锁定，locks/ 目录下保存每个堆栈在当前被 Pulumi 操作时的锁文件。 [evidence:f2155b0a46ee39442c47cb9265e5ea0a6aca9208bd6da747] [evidence:b554a6e010a79561f7aecede303b6d2d1be9d3e97aee37d2] [evidence:890d444540a5b3647d8a55ae929ed95695f4511e661f06b9] [evidence:d7f7d456551a47ac26bf51bc0cb187bbe0c1002379f45d2f] [evidence:711e0e68ce2d2abf0281b051adfdeb91b4fe229680f509cf] [evidence:9fd68972e63da9b39bd31264e2cb8d753980c734deec8855] [evidence:10478f6347733f122d8d1f23bdb07b0e6e9bdc65f5b46a47] [evidence:78d5c8c3c4c99450dbeba6340c641946556d4b1118931a39] [evidence:7cf51ec48ee6af590747768a8dad2bef8237adb5d91ec8bf] [evidence:46336099ebceb046c3cca3109e77cdf6875a7c936231e4c5] [evidence:3530672769e3f752f5b5ed432311521b7b45ad6b8681562c] ## 存储方式：默认本地与多种后端的取舍 Terraform 文档以 local 后端为默认示例：它把状态存储在本地磁盘的 JSON 文件中。若希望集中管理状态，可以集成 HCP Terraform 存储状态数据，或定义 backend 块将状态存入远端对象。文档还说明，使用非本地后端时，Terraform 不会在磁盘上保存状态，唯一例外是写入后端失败这类不可恢复错误发生时。 [evidence:3cac2f01297008a6d06016ce03c206f42bcaaacebc744ff7] [evidence:172dab1d1f228815dbdf2cf3bb9d8dd87389a254fcdacc1c] [evidence:de481c62892df18caa82088dd8abb1d70ad2ee635b993f27] Pulumi 的 filesystem 和云存储后端同样提供本地与远端两种落点：既可以把状态保存在本机，也可以保存在云对象存储中。使用 DIY 后端时，需要在 pulumi login 中指定存储端点 URL，可选前缀包括 s3://、azblob://、gs:// 或 file://。此外，Pulumi 现在也支持以 PostgreSQL 作为 DIY 状态存储选项，但这会带来额外的运维开销；而 Pulumi Cloud 则自动处理备份与恢复、团队协作、RBAC 和审计日志等运维事项。 [evidence:a0bcaf760ba2d59474791145fb84353af7a844e278cfd81b] [evidence:0708d32226e790e7d12cb000657b164fa4a5c42c820f7bbe] [evidence:e06e10be6c5aa9ee407e4db9d2a1480a97c82b71c2b0320b] [evidence:fa00e7e064fa9c97b6727cdee1c9d2da2ebc1d2fb6dadca4] ## 加锁机制与并发修改控制 Terraform 的状态锁定由后端承担：后端在可能的情况下负责支持状态锁定，而并非所有后端都支持锁定，各后端是否支持可在其后端文档中查到。对于支持锁定的后端，所有可能写状态的操作都会自动加锁，以防止其他操作获取锁并损坏状态；锁定过程不产生任何提示信息，但如果状态锁定失败，Terraform 不会继续执行。当需要强制解锁时，force-unlock 命令要求提供唯一的锁 ID，该 ID 会在解锁失败时由 Terraform 输出，并作为 nonce 确保锁与解锁作用于正确的锁。 [evidence:f2155b0a46ee39442c47cb9265e5ea0a6aca9208bd6da747] [evidence:b554a6e010a79561f7aecede303b6d2d1be9d3e97aee37d2] [evidence:890d444540a5b3647d8a55ae929ed95695f4511e661f06b9] [evidence:d7f7d456551a47ac26bf51bc0cb187bbe0c1002379f45d2f] [evidence:711e0e68ce2d2abf0281b051adfdeb91b4fe229680f509cf] [evidence:9fd68972e63da9b39bd31264e2cb8d753980c734deec8855] [evidence:10478f6347733f122d8d1f23bdb07b0e6e9bdc65f5b46a47] Pulumi 的 DIY 后端内置状态锁定与变更历史跟踪，并且对所有 DIY 后端默认启用基本的基于文件的锁定系统。其锁文件存放在 locks/ 目录下，对应每个堆栈在当前正被 Pulumi 操作时的锁定状态。 [evidence:78d5c8c3c4c99450dbeba6340c641946556d4b1118931a39] [evidence:7cf51ec48ee6af590747768a8dad2bef8237adb5d91ec8bf] [evidence:46336099ebceb046c3cca3109e77cdf6875a7c936231e4c5] [evidence:3530672769e3f752f5b5ed432311521b7b45ad6b8681562c] ## 对比表 | 比较维度 | Terraform | Pulumi | | --- | --- | --- | | 状态存储方式 | 默认 local 后端将状态存为本地磁盘 JSON 文件；可集成 HCP Terraform 或用 backend 块存至远端；非本地后端除写入失败外不在磁盘持久化 | filesystem 与云存储后端可存于本机或云对象存储；DIY 后端用 s3://、azblob://、gs:// 或 file:// 端点；支持 PostgreSQL 作为 DIY 选项；Pulumi Cloud 自动处理运维事项 [evidence:3cac2f01297008a6d06016ce03c206f42bcaaacebc744ff7] [evidence:172dab1d1f228815dbdf2cf3bb9d8dd87389a254fcdacc1c] [evidence:de481c62892df18caa82088dd8abb1d70ad2ee635b993f27] [evidence:a0bcaf760ba2d59474791145fb84353af7a844e278cfd81b] [evidence:0708d32226e790e7d12cb000657b164fa4a5c42c820f7bbe] [evidence:e06e10be6c5aa9ee407e4db9d2a1480a97c82b71c2b0320b] [evidence:fa00e7e064fa9c97b6727cdee1c9d2da2ebc1d2fb6dadca4] | | 状态锁定机制 | 由后端负责在可能时支持锁定；并非所有后端都支持，需查各后端文档 | DIY 后端内置状态锁定与变更历史跟踪；所有 DIY 后端默认启用基本文件锁；锁文件位于 locks/ 目录 [evidence:f2155b0a46ee39442c47cb9265e5ea0a6aca9208bd6da747] [evidence:b554a6e010a79561f7aecede303b6d2d1be9d3e97aee37d2] [evidence:890d444540a5b3647d8a55ae929ed95695f4511e661f06b9] [evidence:d7f7d456551a47ac26bf51bc0cb187bbe0c1002379f45d2f] [evidence:3530672769e3f752f5b5ed432311521b7b45ad6b8681562c] [evidence:78d5c8c3c4c99450dbeba6340c641946556d4b1118931a39] [evidence:7cf51ec48ee6af590747768a8dad2bef8237adb5d91ec8bf] [evidence:46336099ebceb046c3cca3109e77cdf6875a7c936231e4c5] | | 并发修改控制行为 | 支持锁定的后端上，所有可能写状态的操作自动加锁；锁定不提示；锁定失败则不继续；force-unlock 需唯一锁 ID 作为 nonce | DIY 后端默认启用基本文件锁，以 locks/ 下的堆栈锁文件控制并发操作 [evidence:711e0e68ce2d2abf0281b051adfdeb91b4fe229680f509cf] [evidence:9fd68972e63da9b39bd31264e2cb8d753980c734deec8855] [evidence:10478f6347733f122d8d1f23bdb07b0e6e9bdc65f5b46a47] [evidence:78d5c8c3c4c99450dbeba6340c641946556d4b1118931a39] [evidence:7cf51ec48ee6af590747768a8dad2bef8237adb5d91ec8bf] [evidence:46336099ebceb046c3cca3109e77cdf6875a7c936231e4c5] | ## State locking happens automatically on all operations that could write
state. You do not see any message that it happens. If state locking fails,
Terraform does not continue.

source_evidence.quote_text:
To protect you, the `force-unlock` command requires a unique lock ID. Terraform
will output this lock ID if unlocking fails. This lock ID acts as a
[nonce](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptographic_nonce), ensuring
that locks and unlocks target the correct lock.
source_evidence.claim_text: force-unlock 命令要求唯一的锁 ID，作为 nonce 确保锁与解锁针对正确的锁。

columns.label: 并发修改控制
columns.description: What mechanism each tool uses to detect or prevent concurrent modifications to the same stack/state (e.g., lock acquisition failure, conflict errors, force-unlock), per official docs.

columns.label: 状态存储方式
columns.description: How each tool stores infrastructure state: local file, remote backend, managed service, and default behavior, with what the official docs state.

columns.label: 状态锁定机制
columns.description: How each tool acquires and releases locks on state (or equivalent) to prevent concurrent operations, including which backends support locking, with official documentation references.

brief.scope: State storage options (backend/service), locking mechanisms, and concurrency control behavior for each tool as described in their official documentation.
brief.objective: Compare Terraform and Pulumi on state storage, locking, and concurrent modification control, citing official documentation with exact quotes, snapshots, and URLs.
exclusions: General feature comparisons beyond state, locking, and concurrency
brief.deliverable: Markdown research report with a citation audit table mapping each claim to quote, snapshot, and URL.

perspectives.name: Implementer
questions: Which backends does each tool support for state and locking?
How does each behave when a lock is already held?

perspectives.name: Decision maker
questions: Which tool offers stronger built-in concurrency safety by default?
What operational setup is needed for safe concurrent use?
